cases.prompt: Make the Drawloom journal landing page feel premium and alive while keeping it restrained and accessible.
Turn the knowledge map into an interactive SVG with equivalent hover, focus, keyboard and touch feedback.
Design idle, starting, running, interrupted, failed, retrying and complete states for the run control.
Polish the loading, partial result, success and failure feedback for this action.
The cards feel dead. Refine their hover, press and focus behaviour without making the page noisy.
Create a recognisable Drawloom moment where separate knowledge threads become a coherent fabric.
Audit the desktop interaction design for abrupt transitions, repeated animations and reduced-motion failures.
Design autosave feedback for an editor where saves may be pending, succeed, fail, or be superseded by a newer edit.
Design a destructive delete interaction for a high-consequence item that must be hard to trigger accidentally but fast for keyboard users.
Design feedback for a sortable, filterable results table whose rows may update optimistically and later be rejected.
Rewrite the hero headline and supporting paragraph without changing layout or behaviour.
Review whether the existing gold and violet palette communicates the intended brand meaning.
Correct the path geometry of this static SVG logo; do not animate or make it interactive.
Define the provider-neutral backend retry contract; there is no user-interface change.
Reorder the article sections to improve the engineering story without changing interactive behaviour.
